# Pinned browser libraries

Downloaded from jsDelivr on 2026-10-16. They are served from this site, never executed from a CDN. Integrity hashes are in integrity.json and index.html. This pins the versions used in local checks; it does not certify the absence of vulnerabilities.

- Supabase JS 2.117.2: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2/dist/umd/supabase.js (MIT; https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/blob/master/LICENSE). Matches the cached Edge runtime dependency.
- Chart.js 4.4.4: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.4/dist/chart.umd.min.js (MIT; https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/v4.4.4/LICENSE.md).

Review advisories and upgrade deliberately. Update the file, integrity manifest and HTML together, then exercise charts and MFA locally.
